g.text: 36 completed paired panels · six topics · 4, 8 and 16 participants · real OpenRouter calls

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #68717d

g.text: Purple: extracted claims · Copper: grouped claims · Dots: completed panels; larger markers count overlap
Controlled synthetic benchmark · provisional model-judged results
Coverage is the fraction of unique source propositions fully preserved; partial preservation does not receive full credit. Faithfulness is the fraction
of output claims judged fully supported. Sizes are nested within topic and replicate. Panels c–d show individual panels and unweighted means,
not confidence intervals. A separate model judges each stage against original source text. These are benchmark prompts, not a test of the deployed
Symphonia extraction pipeline. Templated inputs and the eight-claim grouping cap limit generalisation. Full inputs, outputs and audits are downloadable.
